layers.L3: existing participant roles and independent disposition
layers.L4: bounded increment with durable attempt/effect record
layers.L5: optional bus carrying references, not scientific authority

stop_precedence: Native denial, scope conflict, missing mandatory evidence or unknown external effect stops dependent effects immediately.
All required sensors pass: preserve candidate and stop development, pending independent disposition.
The supplied maximum two failed offline iterations applies only within actually approved scope and persists across turns.
No iteration or retry allowance is created by this reference; live attempts retain their own original limits.
A final answer/checkpoint does not require completion of a blocked consequential action.
review_boundary: Implementer cannot silently weaken required evaluator, thresholds, dataset or exclusions.
Test pass, review acceptance, branch publication, site display and live execution are distinct.
Reasoned same-score/exclusion handling must retain negative evidence; no narrative-only success.
memory_rules: Use short index descriptions to select sources; read enough of the required complete contract.
Preserve exact originals independently from mutable wiki/indexer output.
Enforce record access outside indexing; do not trust custom code hooks on retrieval.
Retain reviewed method/rule cards with failure signature, evidence, applicability, version and retirement trigger.
browser_routing: Existing supported API/connector first for exact operations.
Scripted browser plus assertion first for predictable UI checks.
Stagehand or Browser Use only for a demonstrated adaptive-browser need.
Browser Harness generated helpers remain unaccepted candidates until scoped review.
Desktop personal-cookie transfer and broad session use not authorized.
Cloudflare Browser Run is an execution provider requiring its own real account/limits, not a bypass.
browser_controls: Isolated approved profile and destination/action scope
No source text treated as permission or installation instruction
Explicit step/time/data/cost limits and native operation receipt
Do not put submit actions in retrying assertion/code blocks
Protect traces before disclosure; no cookies/tokens/credential URLs in public artifacts
Disconnect, cancel request and termination distinct

sensors.name: Input/source binding
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: An altered selected input is rejected; record exact expected versus actual identity.
sensors.limit: No full archive replay; inspect the task-required bytes.

sensors.name: Capture and cameras
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Retain eligible/excluded counts, registration components and pose-control results; declared limits must pass.
sensors.limit: Thresholds not specified here; no capture performed.

sensors.name: Bounded training smoke
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Finite loss/updates, render/checkpoint/reload; selected densification boundary covered by a separately declared case.
sensors.limit: 200 steps alone cannot establish normal convergence or densification under original defaults.

sensors.name: Held-out scene quality
sensors.basis: Supplied L1 and existing Gaussian plan
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Frozen split/metric/render settings; report appearance and geometry independently.
sensors.limit: No post-result split changes, no missing metric treated as pass.

sensors.name: Grounding and reuse
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Supported answer cites originals; unsupported/unknown-scale answer stays limited; second actual consumer returns evidence.
sensors.limit: Fixtures and shared URLs do not count as real consumer use.

sensors.name: Oracle sensitivity
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Known-wrong control is detected; mutation categories and limitations retained.
sensors.limit: Equivalent mutants and infrastructure failures are not silently scored as ordinary failures or successes.

sensors.name: Current access and source-instruction boundary
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Revoked/excluded-protected bytes not served; injected source instruction causes zero unauthorized effects.
sensors.limit: Wiki index exclusion is not an authorization implementation.

sensors.name: Ambiguous effect and stopping
sensors.basis: Existing F2 boundary and actual missing durable recovery
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Identify submitted effect; block new dependent effects; preserve receipt and distinguish disconnect/requested cancellation/termination.
sensors.limit: Existing inactive F2 acceptance not reopened; native/durable checks unrun.

sensors.name: Response and successor completion
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Bounded task returns answer or checkpoint; next reader locates state without outgoing final reply or duplicate execution.
sensors.limit: Prompt time targets do not interrupt a stalled native call.

sensors.name: Website publication and actual use
sensors.proposed_pass_criterion: Verify rendered reference ID/version, linked machine data and intended-reader access; record actual consumption separately.
sensors.limit: Repository commit or HTTP status alone fails website acceptance.

role_mapping.implementation: existing Codex under its work order
role_mapping.adversarial_review: existing independent review path, not automatic new bot
role_mapping.librarian: proposed future authorized role; Claude remains held
role_mapping.human: scope, access, spending and release decisions

measurement.claim_10x: Only a named measured ratio under comparable conditions; no general 10x or exponential result.

next: Use reference in the next approved work-order design; keep current producer-binding reconciliation and website publishing authority separate. No new training, review replay or runtime installation.
